_comment: sim-carton-level-setdown-v1 collect place SET-DOWN carton level. Purpose: stop the carton-level guard tripping in the PLACE set-down at the PR-307 south dock (coldwin33: CARTON_TILT roll=-0.09 pitch=+2.06 deg, phase=place, sustained 0.150s = the 0.150s grace), the residual that sim-carton-level-southdock-v1's gravity_compensation (stiffness 2850) left after it closed the preplace droop (set-down moved only 2.07->2.06). Root cause: PR 311's full-DOF level place IK spread the droop-cancelling pre-tilt onto the HEAVY shoulder_lift/elbow pitch joints, which are gravity-PINNED at the far-extended loaded set-down (the GPU moved the executed carton 0.01 deg for a +2.04 deg command pre-tilt, d(exec)/d(cmd) ~ 0). The WRIST tracks its command faithfully (coldwin33 lift/tuck/preplace executed matched the geometric plan within 0.02 deg). The fix routes the droop-cancelling pre-tilt onto the TRACKING wrist (GravityCompensation.correct_joints, default the wrist cluster), so the physical welded carton lands level; the wrist pre-rotation follows the extension (sag = tau/K, tau grows with reach). The captain-fixed 2.0 deg bound and 0.15 s grace are UNCHANGED. Absent gravity_compensation => byte-identical.
_no_config_change_from_pr311: This is the SAME gravity_compensation block as sim-carton-level-southdock-v1 (docs/examples/carton-level-southdock-mission-fragment.json). The fix is in HOW the compensation is realised (wrist-routed, not heavy-routed), not in the config -- so the integration lane needs NO config edit beyond what it already runs. GravityCompensation.correct_joints defaults to the wrist cluster (ur_wrist_1/2/3); override only if a future geometry needs a different tracking set.
_carton_level_note: Keep the rest of the carton_level block exactly as the lane runs it (bound_deg 2.0, tilt_grace_s 0.15, level_goals/level_place/level_path on). carton_level is a HOST key (config_preflight: HOST) -- it must be in the host config the manip host reads (scripts/twin/restock_manipulation/ros_host_config.json merge / the integration host block), not a runtime-only file, or it silently never activates.
_gravity_compensation_note: stiffness_nm_per_rad is the EFFECTIVE droop stiffness (N*m/rad) that SIZES the heavy-joint sag the wrist must cancel. 2850 reproduces coldwin31/coldwin33's ~2 deg set-down droop (model south 1.99 deg, east 1.82 deg). carton_mass_kg is the welded handling-unit mass lumped at the tool (juice_orange profile mass 0.45). max_pretilt_rad (default 0.12) clamps the modelled sag. LOWER stiffness => MORE wrist pre-tilt; raise it if the in-sim executed over-corrects (overshoots level the other way).
_bounded_gpu_proof: Cold collect-only (RESTOCK_COLLECT_GROUND_TRUTH=1 if the source decode is not the focus, visuals per the lane) at the PR-307 south dock geometry (mission_poses.place_approach for the (-4.60, 16.0, -pi/2) dock), through scripts/run_mobile_restock.py under /tmp/aile-gpu.lock, with carton_level.gravity_compensation in the HOST block. Expected PASS: every CARTON_SEGMENT_TILT phase=<segment> line (lift, tuck, transit, preplace, PLACE, RELEASE) under 2.0 with margin; a successful weld; a successful release; NO CARTON_TILT / HOST_FAULT_ESTOP through place and release (the set-down lands the welded carton level). orch-console.log now carries the per-segment CARTON_SEGMENT_TILT phase=place|release planned=<deg> executed=<deg> lines (the set-down previously reported only through the trip). Tune: if the place executed residual is still off ~0, adjust stiffness_nm_per_rad from the logged executed -- LOWER stiffness => more wrist pre-tilt. Do NOT loosen bound_deg or tilt_grace_s (captain-fixed).
